A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same Jigsaw-Puzzles benchmark. All 12 pages of each version, including tables, figures, and appendices, support reliable comparison; appendix reorganization does not remove material.

before.justification: v1 reports original evaluations of 24 VLMs, human performance on Jigsaw-Puzzles-Lite, and additional analyses in Tables 2–3 and Figures 5–8.

after.justification: v3 retains the original VLM evaluations, human results, and supplementary analyses in Tables 2–3 and Figures 5–8.

M1.justification: Section 3 retains the same image-curation pipeline, CLIP-based hard distractors, puzzle construction procedures, and task definitions. The appendix prompt templates are also unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same 1,100 CC3M-derived images and five core puzzle tasks, plus the 220-image Jigsaw-Puzzles-Lite subset and its open-ended Order Generation task.

E2.justification: Table 2 retains the same 24 VLMs and baseline rows; Table 3 and Figure 8 retain their respective model and human comparisons. The newly cited puzzle-learning studies are not evaluated comparators.

E3.justification: Section 4.1 retains zero-shot multi-image evaluation, exact-match accuracy, and the 220-image human evaluation with three participants. Difficulty settings, task prompts, and hardware allocations are unchanged.

E4.justification: The task-correlation analysis, model-size analysis, Gemini self-correction case study, and comparison of Order Restoration with Order Generation are unchanged (Figures 5–8).

E5.justification: Both retain the same p=0.05 random-guessing significance thresholds and statistical displays. Neither adds or revises repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, or uncertainty-estimation procedures.

E6.justification: Tables 2–3 have identical result entries, and the result figures are unchanged. Gemini-2.5-Pro retains 77.14% overall accuracy on the full benchmark and 30.00% on Order Generation; human Order Generation accuracy remains 94.09%.

T1.justification: Neither version introduces formal theorems, proofs, or mathematical derivations. The descriptive task definitions and statistical reasoning are unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution list, and conclusion retain the same benchmark, scalability, evaluation, and human–VLM performance-gap claims. The added comparison with puzzle-learning research clarifies positioning without changing these central claims.

C2.justification: Interpretations concerning spatial understanding, model size, and option-assisted self-correction are retained. Both state the same limitation to static 2D images, excluding 3D perception, temporal sequences, and embodied contexts.

D1.justification: v3 adds a project-page URL to the abstract, supplying access information absent from v1. Curation rules, prompt templates, and hardware details remain unchanged; Appendix C reorganizes previously disclosed hardware information.

R1.justification: The introduction adds Noroozi and Favaro (2016), Wang et al. (2022), and Shen et al. (2024), distinguishing their puzzle-based representation learning from this benchmark's evaluation of VLM spatial reasoning. The remaining research positioning is retained.

P1.justification: v3 makes limited wording and affiliation/header edits, adds acknowledgments, and reorganizes the appendix into separately labeled sections A–C. The main narrative and section sequence remain substantially unchanged.

P2.justification: Appendix figures are repositioned, notably moving Figures 14–16 from page 11 to page 12 and rearranging Figures 17–18. All 18 figure images and the table designs are retained; the changes concern placement and page flow.

improvement.justification: v3 modestly improves usability and scholarly context through an explicit project-page pointer, clearer acknowledgment of earlier puzzle-learning research, and separately labeled appendices. The experimental evidence and limitations remain unchanged, so the gains are limited to documentation and presentation. The PDFs do not establish the linked resources' availability.
